patthana18.1:2.1: hetuṃ sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na hetuṃ sahetukaṃ dhammā paṭicca na na hetu na sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana18.1:3.1: hetuṃ sahetukañca na hetuṃ sahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana18.1:4.1: hetuyā tīṇi. ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate pañca,
patthana18.1:5.1: na hetuṃ sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu na sahetuko dhammo uppajjati na hetupaccayā,
patthana18.1:6.1: na hetuyā ekaṃ. na ārammaṇe tīṇi, no vigate tīṇi.
patthana18.1:8.1: hetu sahetuko dhammo na hetussa na sahetukassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo,
patthana18.1:9.1: hetu sahetuko dhammo na hetussa na sahetukassa dhammassa ārammaṇa paccayena paccayo. na hetu sahetuko dhammo na na hetussa na sahetukassa dhammassa ārammaṇa paccayena paccayo, hetu sahetuko dhammo na hetussa na sahetukassa ca na na hetussa na sahetukassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇa paccayena paccayo, na hetu sahetuko dhammo na na hetussa na sahetukassa dhammassa ārammaṇa paccayena paccayo,
patthana18.1:11.1: hetu sahetuko dhammo na hetussa na sahetukassa dhammassa ārammaṇa paccayena paccayo; na hetu sahetuko dhammo na hetussa na sahetukassa ca na na hetussa na sahetukassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇa paccayena paccayo,
patthana18.1:12.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe cha. adhipatiyā dve, avigate pañca, (pañhāvāraṃ vitthāretabbaṃ).
patthana18.1:13.1: hetuṃ ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na ahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana18.1:14.1: na hetuṃ ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu na ahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
